member.name: M:Hexalith.Builds.Tooling.CheckSuites.CheckSuiteContract.TimestampPattern
member.remarks:
Pattern:
^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}(?:\\.[0-9]{1,7})?(?:Z|[+-][0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2})\\z
Options:
RegexOptions.CultureInvariant
Explanation:
○ Match if at the beginning of the string.
○ Match a character in the set [0-9] exactly 4 times.
○ Match '-'.
○ Match a character in the set [0-9] exactly 2 times.
○ Match '-'.
○ Match a character in the set [0-9] exactly 2 times.
○ Match 'T'.
○ Match a character in the set [0-9] exactly 2 times.
○ Match ':'.
○ Match a character in the set [0-9] exactly 2 times.
○ Match ':'.
○ Match a character in the set [0-9] exactly 2 times.
○ Optional (greedy).
○ Match '.'.
○ Match a character in the set [0-9] atomically at least 1 and at most 7 times.
○ Match with 2 alternative expressions.
○ Match 'Z'.
○ Match a sequence of expressions.
○ Match a character in the set [+\-].
○ Match a character in the set [0-9] exactly 2 times.
○ Match ':'.
○ Match a character in the set [0-9] exactly 2 times.
○ Match if at the end of the string.

member.name: M:Hexalith.Builds.Tooling.CheckSuites.CheckSuiteContract.PathPattern
member.remarks:
Pattern:
^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+(?:/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+)*\\z
Options:
RegexOptions.CultureInvariant
Explanation:
○ Match if at the beginning of the string.
○ Match a character in the set [\-.0-9A-Z_a-z] greedily at least once.
○ Loop greedily any number of times.
○ Match '/'.
○ Match a character in the set [\-.0-9A-Z_a-z] atomically at least once.
○ Match if at the end of the string.

○ Match '@'.

member.name: M:Hexalith.Builds.Tooling.Manifest.PlatformVersionCatalog.ImageRegex
member.remarks:
Pattern:
^[a-z0-9]+(?:(?:[._]|__|-+)[a-z0-9]+)*(?:/[a-z0-9]+(?:(?:[._]|__|-+)[a-z0-9]+)*)*$
Options:
RegexOptions.CultureInvariant
Explanation:
○ Match if at the beginning of the string.
○ Match a character in the set [0-9a-z] greedily at least once.
○ Loop greedily any number of times.
○ Match with 3 alternative expressions.
○ Match a character in the set [._].
○ Match the string "__".
○ Match '-' atomically at least once.
○ Match a character in the set [0-9a-z] greedily at least once.
○ Loop greedily any number of times.
○ Match '/'.
○ Match a character in the set [0-9a-z] greedily at least once.
○ Loop greedily any number of times.
○ Match with 3 alternative expressions.
○ Match a character in the set [._].
○ Match the string "__".
○ Match '-' atomically at least once.
○ Match a character in the set [0-9a-z] atomically at least once.
○ Match if at the end of the string or if before an ending newline.

member.name: M:Hexalith.Builds.Tooling.Manifest.PlatformVersionCatalog.TagRegex
member.remarks:
Pattern:
^[A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,127}$
Options:
RegexOptions.CultureInvariant
Explanation:
○ Match if at the beginning of the string.
○ Match a character in the set [0-9A-Z_a-z].
○ Match a character in the set [\-.0-9A-Z_a-z] atomically at most 127 times.
○ Match if at the end of the string or if before an ending newline.

member.name: M:Hexalith.Builds.Tooling.Manifest.PlatformVersionCatalog.DigestRegex
member.remarks:
Pattern:
^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$
Options:
RegexOptions.CultureInvariant
Explanation:
○ Match if at the beginning of the string.
○ Match the string "sha256:".
○ Match a lowercase hexadecimal digit exactly 64 times.
○ Match if at the end of the string or if before an ending newline.

member.name: M:Hexalith.Builds.Tooling.RunEvidence.ModuleRunEvidenceFactory.RevisionRegex
member.remarks:
Pattern:
^[0-9a-fA-F]{40,64}$
Options:
RegexOptions.CultureInvariant
Explanation:
○ Match if at the beginning of the string.
○ Match a hexadecimal digit atomically at least 40 and at most 64 times.
○ Match if at the end of the string or if before an ending newline.

member.name: M:Hexalith.Builds.Tooling.RunEvidence.ModuleRunEvidenceFactory.SdkVersionRegex
member.remarks:
Pattern:
^\\d+\\.\\d+\\.\\d+(?:[-+][0-9A-Za-z.-]+)?$
Options:
RegexOptions.CultureInvariant
Explanation:
○ Match if at the beginning of the string.
○ Match a Unicode digit atomically at least once.
○ Match '.'.
○ Match a Unicode digit atomically at least once.
○ Match '.'.
○ Match a Unicode digit greedily at least once.
○ Optional (greedy).
○ Match a character in the set [+\-].
○ Match a character in the set [\-.0-9A-Za-z] atomically at least once.
○ Match if at the end of the string or if before an ending newline.

member.name: T:Hexalith.Builds.Tooling.Runtime.CompositionAspireHostPaths
member.summary: Local Aspire orchestration paths that replace the build-machine paths an AppHost bakes into its assembly metadata.
member.remarks: A packaged AppHost carries the DCP, dashboard, project and intermediate-output paths of the machine that built it. The runner resolves DCP and the dashboard from this machine's NuGet global packages folder at the catalog Aspire version, and gives the AppHost directory and the Aspire store a run-private directory. A missing package is a prerequisite failure; no other location is tried.

○ Match a character in the set [Nn].
○ Match a character in the set [ :] atomically at least once.

member.remarks:
Pattern:
^v(?:0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(?:0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(?:0|[1-9][0-9]*)(?:-[0-9A-Za-z-]+(?:\\.[0-9A-Za-z-]+)*)?(?:\\+[0-9A-Za-z-]+(?:\\.[0-9A-Za-z-]+)*)?$
Explanation:
○ Match if at the beginning of the string.
○ Match 'v'.
○ Match with 2 alternative expressions.
○ Match '0'.
○ Match a sequence of expressions.
○ Match a character in the set [1-9].
○ Match a character in the set [0-9] atomically any number of times.
○ Match '.'.
○ Match with 2 alternative expressions.
○ Match '0'.
○ Match a sequence of expressions.
○ Match a character in the set [1-9].
○ Match a character in the set [0-9] atomically any number of times.
○ Match '.'.
○ Match with 2 alternative expressions.
○ Match '0'.
○ Match a sequence of expressions.
○ Match a character in the set [1-9].
○ Match a character in the set [0-9] greedily any number of times.
○ Optional (greedy).
○ Match '-'.
○ Match a character in the set [\-0-9A-Za-z] greedily at least once.
○ Loop greedily any number of times.
○ Match '.'.
○ Match a character in the set [\-0-9A-Za-z] greedily at least once.
○ Optional (greedy).
○ Match '+'.
○ Match a character in the set [\-0-9A-Za-z] greedily at least once.
○ Loop greedily any number of times.
○ Match '.'.
○ Match a character in the set [\-0-9A-Za-z] atomically at least once.
○ Match if at the end of the string or if before an ending newline.

member.name: M:Hexalith.Builds.Tooling.Workspace.SubmoduleInitializer.GitCredentialPattern
member.remarks:
Pattern:
(?<scheme>[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9+.-]*://)\\S+@
Options:
RegexOptions.CultureInvariant
Explanation:
○ "scheme" capture group.
○ Match an ASCII letter.
○ Match a character in the set [+\-.0-9A-Za-z] atomically any number of times.
○ Match the string "://".
○ Match any character other than a whitespace character greedily at least once.
○ Match '@'.
